label: Show Gold Rule
help_text: A short gold rule above the eyebrow. Works with or without eyebrow text.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Visual size, independent of the heading level. Follows theme typography.

name: animate_heading
label: Type Heading On Scroll
help_text: The heading types itself in the first time it scrolls into view. Plays once, and is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

children.name: image
children.label: Image
children.help_text: Optional. Shown beside the heading and cross-faded as this milestone becomes active. Leave blank to keep the previous milestone's image.

default.title: Virtua PR is born
default.text: Jasna starts out as a freelance digital PR consultant, working with the first wave of online-first brands.

image.alt: Team at work in the early studio

default.title: We are just Virtua
default.text: A partnership forms and the freelance practice becomes a full agency.

default.title: Virtua PR is back
default.text: The company splits and the agency begins working with clients well beyond its home market.

default.title: Actuado is born
default.text: After eighteen years the agency rebrands, sharpening its focus on revenue operations and CRM.

default.title: HubSpot Gold Partner
default.text: The first tier in a partnership that would come to define how we deliver.

default.title: HubSpot Platinum Partner
default.text: Recognition of a growing portfolio of complex, multi-entity implementations.

default.title: Vidyard certified
default.text: Video added to the toolkit for sales enablement and customer onboarding.

default.title: HubSpot Diamond Partner
default.text: Diamond tier, earned in delivery rather than resale.

name: year_size
label: Year Size
help_text: Large suits years on a company timeline. Small is better when the number is a step in a sequence and the title should lead.

name: layout_mode
label: Desktop Layout
help_text: Horizontal pins the section and moves the milestones sideways. Vertical stacks them either side of a centred line. Below 992px the vertical layout is always used.

name: cards_in_view
label: Milestones In View
help_text: How many milestones are visible at once. Horizontal layout only.

name: show_images
label: Show Images
help_text: Displays the milestone images beside the heading, cross-fading as you scroll. Hidden automatically if no milestone has an image.
